title: SEC1: bt5.2 admin config breaks existing non-loopback deploys
description: bt5.2 hardens admin config validation: a non-loopback admin.addr without allow_non_loopback=true is now a hard startup error. Any operator who previously had admin.addr bound to 0.0.0.0 (perhaps for Prometheus scraping from another host) will get an immediate startup failure after upgrading. The error message is clear ('set admin.allow_non_loopback = true and admin.bearer_token'), but there are no release notes or migration instructions anywhere in the repo. Risk: production daemon refuses to start after upgrade with no in-band signal other than a stderr message. Mitigation: add a CHANGELOG entry or upgrade note before first release; consider a warn-then-continue grace period for the first version, or at minimum ensure the error message names the exact TOML keys to add.
